title: Purchasing & Stores Controller
intro: An engineering business in Telford is looking for a hands-on stores and purchasing professional. Reporting to the Head of Procurement, you will make sure stock is received, controlled and available to the manufacturing team, while handling day to day purchasing and supplier contact.
bullets: Raise and expedite purchase orders and manage supplier communication
Run the stores counter, receiving, booking in and locating deliveries
Pick and issue components and keep workshop consumables stocked
Carry out stock checks and resolve discrepancies
Arrange UK and overseas transport, and drive the forklift and company van as needed
outro: This is an active, on your feet role based in the stores and workshop, including manual handling of parcels up to 30kg (training is provided). This form takes around 12 minutes.
